name: CWLAtomicBase
abstract: Direct CWL definition instead of the graph representation. Shared by the root CommandLineTool/ExpressionTool document and its nested-in-step form; not typically profiled on its own.

examples.title: CommandLineTool at the document root
examples.content:
A `CommandLineTool` defined directly at the document root, without the `$graph` wrapper — the
typical shape for a single-tool Application Package. No `id` is needed since there is nothing
else in the document to cross-reference it.

examples.title: ExpressionTool with no inputs
examples.content:
An `ExpressionTool` computing its output purely from an inline expression, with an empty
`inputs` list.
